name: CE21 Suite
author: CE21

sections.description: This plugin allows you to add CE21 components to your WordPress site. It includes widgets for displaying classified ads, directory of members, a calendar of programs, and a shortcode for displaying CE21 resources.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for CE21 Suite.
  3. Install and activate the CE21 Suite plugin.
  4. In the WordPress admin panel, go to CE21 > API Settings. Enter Base URL, Client ID, and Secret Key. These can be found on the CE21 Manager under Settings > API Settings.
  5. Catalog URL is the location of the CE21 catalog (e.g., https://abc.ce21.com).
